'''Charnso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila Spaceport]], he acted as a liaison between the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Merile Yurrion]] and a fellow Imperial.<ref name="TOR" />
